'''Rod Latham Masses Against The Classes''' is a [[Light]] deck by [[Rod Latham]], published on [[Trandosite]].<ref name="trandosite">[http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com/ls109.htm Masses Against The Classes], [[Trandosite]] ([[Rod Latham]]).
